ImmUnregisterWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a register string from the dictionary of the IME associated with the given input locale.

ImmEnumRegisterWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the register strings having the specified reading, style and register string, calling an application callback for each.

ShellAbout@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays the standard Windows About dialog box with the given title, extra text and icon.

DuplicateIcon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a duplicate of the specified icon and returns the handle of the copy.

ExtractAssociatedIcon@WIN32API.INC.desc: Gets the icon stored in a file or in the executable associated with the file; returns an icon handle. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "ExtractAssociatedIconA".

SHAppBarMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends an appbar message (ABM_*) to the system, e.g. to register an application desktop toolbar or query the taskbar position.

DoEnvironmentSubst@WIN32API.INC.desc: Replaces environment variable references (%NAME%) in a string buffer with their values. Not recommended; use ExpandEnvironmentStrings instead.

FindEnvironmentString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: undocumented shell32 export that apparently looks up an environment variable string by name.

ExtractIconEx_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves handles to large and/or small icons from an executable, DLL or icon file; returns the number of icons extracted (or total count if index is -1).

SHFileOperation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies, moves, renames or deletes file system objects as described in a SHFILEOPSTRUCT; returns 0 on success. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "SHFileOperationA".

SHFreeNameMappings@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees a file name mapping object returned by SHFileOperation.

WinExecError@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: undocumented shell32 export that apparently displays an error message box for a failed WinExec call.

Shell_NotifyIcon_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds, modifies or deletes an icon in the taskbar notification area (system tray) using a NOTIFYICONDATA structure.

SHGetFileInfo_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a file system object, such as its icon, display name or type name, into a SHFILEINFO structure.

SHGetNewLinkInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a unique name for a new shortcut (link) file for the given target path.

VerFindFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines where a file should be installed based on whether it is shared and whether a copy already exists.

VerInstallFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a file, decompressing it if needed, after checking version information against an existing copy. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "VerInstallFileA".

GetFileVersionInfoSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the size in bytes of the version-information resource of a file, or 0 if it has none.

GetFileVersionInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads the version-information resource of a file into a buffer; call GetFileVersionInfoSize first to get the buffer size.

VerLanguageName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the name of the language associated with a binary language identifier.

VerQueryValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a value (such as fixed file info or a string) from a version-information buffer filled by GetFileVersionInfo. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "VerQueryValueA".

HeapValidate@WIN32API.INC.desc: Validates the specified heap or a single block in it; returns nonzero if valid.

HeapCompact@WIN32API.INC.desc: Coalesces adjacent free blocks in a heap and returns the size of the largest committed free block.

HeapLock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Acquires the critical section (lock) of the specified heap.

HeapUnlock@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases the lock on a heap acquired by HeapLock.

GetBinaryType@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether a file is executable and, if so, what type (32-bit, 64-bit, DOS, 16-bit, etc.).

GetShortPathName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the short (8.3) path form of the specified path; returns the length of the result. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "GetShortPathNameA".

GetProcessAffinityMask@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the process affinity mask of a process and the system affinity mask.

LogonUser@WIN32API.INC.desc: Logs a user on to the local computer with user name, domain and password and returns a token handle for that user.

ImpersonateLoggedOnUser@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets the calling thread impersonate the security context of a logged-on user given by a token handle. WIN32API.INC declared it from kernel32; the build uses advapi32.

CreateProcessAsUser@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new process and its primary thread that runs in the security context of the user represented by a token. WIN32API.INC declared it from kernel32; the build uses advapi32.

GetOpenFileName_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the common Open file dialog box configured by an OPENFILENAME structure; returns nonzero if the user selected a file.

GetSaveFileName_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the common Save As dialog box configured by an OPENFILENAME structure; returns nonzero if the user chose a file name.

GetFileTitle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the name of the specified file (without path) as it would be displayed to the user.

ChooseColorDlg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the common Color dialog box using a CHOOSECOLOR structure; returns nonzero if the user clicked OK.

FindText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a modeless system Find dialog box; returns its window handle. The ALIAS in WIN32API.INC was wrong; the build uses "FindTextA".

ReplaceText@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a modeless system Replace dialog box; returns its window handle.

ChooseFontDlg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the common Font dialog box using a CHOOSEFONT structure; returns nonzero if the user clicked OK.

PrinterDlg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the common Print dialog box using a PRINTDLG structure; returns nonzero if the user clicked OK.

PageSetupDlg_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Shows the Page Setup dialog box for paper size, orientation and margins using a PAGESETUPDLG structure.

DdeInitialize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers an application with the Dynamic Data Exchange Management Library (DDEML) and returns an instance identifier.

SetServiceBits@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers a service type with the service control manager and the Server service.

CopyLZFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a source file to a destination, expanding it if it is LZ-compressed. Obsolete; use LZCopy instead.

LZStart@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: obsolete lz32 export that allocates buffers for CopyLZFile; does nothing in Win32.

LZDone@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: obsolete lz32 export that frees buffers allocated by LZStart; does nothing in Win32.

mciGetYieldProc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the address of the yield callback function associated with an MCI device's wait flag.

mciSetYieldProc@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the address of a callback procedure called periodically while an MCI device waits for a command with the wait flag.

midiOutGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of MIDI output devices present in the system.

mmioInstallIOProcA@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs or removes a custom multimedia I/O procedure, or locates an installed one by its four-character code.

CommandLineToArgv@WIN32API.INC.desc: Parses a Unicode command line string into an array of argument pointers (argv style) and returns the argument count.

IsTextUnicode@WIN32API.INC.desc: Uses statistical tests to determine whether a buffer is likely to contain Unicode text.

NotifyChangeEventLog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Lets an application receive notification (an event is signaled) when an event is written to the specified event log.

SetThreadToken@WIN32API.INC.desc: Assigns an impersonation token to a thread, or stops the thread from using one.

CommConfigDialog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a driver-supplied configuration dialog box for a communications device (serial port).

CreateIoCompletionPort@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates an I/O completion port or associates a file handle with an existing port.

DisableThreadLibraryCalls@WIN32API.INC.desc: Disables DLL_THREAD_ATTACH and DLL_THREAD_DETACH notifications for the specified DLL.

EnumResourceLanguages@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the languages of resources with a given type and name in a module, calling a callback for each.

EnumResourceNames@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates resources of a given type in a module, calling a callback with each resource name.

EnumResourceTypes@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the resource types in a module, calling a callback for each type.

FreeEnvironmentStrings@WIN32API.INC.desc: Frees a block of environment strings returned by GetEnvironmentStrings.

FreeLibraryAndExitThread@WIN32API.INC.desc: Decrements the reference count of a loaded DLL and then exits the calling thread.

FreeResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete in 32-bit Windows; resources are freed automatically. Kept for 16-bit compatibility.

GetCommConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current configuration of a communications device into a COMMCONFIG structure.

GetCompressedFileSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the actual number of bytes of disk storage used by a file, taking compression or sparseness into account.

GetDefaultCommConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the default configuration for the specified communications device.

GetHandleInformation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves property flags (inherit, protect from close) of an object handle.

GetProcessHeaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of active heaps of the calling process and retrieves their handles.

GetProcessWorkingSetSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the minimum and maximum working set sizes of the specified process.

GetQueuedCompletionStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Waits to dequeue an I/O completion packet from an I/O completion port.

GetSystemTimeAdjustment@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the system applies periodic time adjustments to its clock, and their size and period.

GlobalCompact@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Always returns the amount of free memory, without compacting.

GlobalFix@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Locks a global memory object like GlobalLock.

GlobalUnfix@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Unlocks a global memory object like GlobalUnlock.

GlobalWire@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Locks a global memory object like GlobalLock.

GlobalUnWire@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Unlocks a global memory object like GlobalUnlock.

IsBadCodePtr@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the calling process has read access to memory at the given address. Obsolete; Microsoft advises not to use it.

LocalCompact@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Has no effect in 32-bit Windows.

LocalShrink@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; provided only for 16-bit compatibility. Has no effect in 32-bit Windows.

SetCommConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the current configuration of a communications device from a COMMCONFIG structure.

SetDefaultCommConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the default configuration for a communications device.

SetFileApisToANSI@WIN32API.INC.desc: Makes the file I/O functions of the process use the ANSI code page instead of the OEM code page.

SetHandleInformation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets property flags (inherit, protect from close) of an object handle.

SetProcessWorkingSetSize@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the minimum and maximum working set sizes of the specified process.

lstrcat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Appends one string to another and returns a pointer to the result. Microsoft warns it can overrun buffers; use StringCchCat instead.

lstrcpyn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies up to a given number of characters from a source string to a buffer, always null-terminating it.

lstrcpy@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a string to a buffer and returns a pointer to the buffer. Microsoft warns it can overrun buffers; use StringCchCopy instead.

SetSystemTimeAdjustment@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enables or disables periodic time adjustments to the system clock (time-of-day clock).

SetThreadAffinityMask@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the processor affinity mask of a thread; returns the previous mask, or 0 on failure.

SetUnhandledExceptionFilter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a top-level exception filter called for unhandled exceptions; returns the previous filter.

SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime@WIN32API.desc: Converts a UTC time to the corresponding local time in the given time zone.

WriteFileEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes data to a file asynchronously and calls a completion routine when done or canceled; requires an overlapped handle.

ChoosePixelFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Finds the device context pixel format that best matches a PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR; returns its index (OpenGL).

DescribePixelFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Fills a PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR with the description of a pixel format of a device context; returns the maximum format index.

EnumMetaFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the records in a Windows-format metafile, calling a callback for each record.

EnumObjects@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the pens or brushes available for a device context, calling a callback for each.

FixBrushOrgEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not implemented; provided for compatibility with Win32s. Microsoft says it should not be used.

GetBrushOrgEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current brush origin of the specified device context.

GetDIBColorTable@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves RGB color entries from the color table of the DIB section selected into a device context.

GetPixelFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the index of the pixel format currently selected into a device context.

LineDDA@WIN32API.INC.desc: Computes the successive points of a line and passes each point to an application-defined callback.

SetAbortProcedure@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the application-defined abort function that lets a print job be canceled during spooling.

SetDIBColorTable@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets RGB color entries in the color table of the DIB section selected into a device context.

SetPixelFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the pixel format of a device context to the format given by an index (used for OpenGL).

SwapBuffers@WIN32API.INC.desc: Exchanges the front and back buffers if the pixel format of the device context has a back buffer (OpenGL).

EnumCalendarInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates calendar information for a locale, calling a callback for each item. Microsoft recommends EnumCalendarInfoEx.

GetCurrencyFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Formats a number string as a currency string for the specified locale.

GetNumberFormat@WIN32API.INC.desc: Formats a number string as a number string customized for the specified locale.

GetStringTypeEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves character type information (CT_CTYPE1/2/3) for the characters of a string.

GetStringTypeW@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves character type information for the characters of a Unicode string.

SetLocaleInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets an item of information in the user override portion of the current locale.

DeletePrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes the specified printer object; the handle must be opened with delete access.

FindClosePrinterChangeNotification@WIN32.desc: Closes a change notification object created by FindFirstPrinterChangeNotification.

FindFirstPrinterChangeNotification@WIN32.desc: Creates a change notification object that is signaled when the specified printer or print server changes.

FindNextPrinterChangeNotification@WIN32A.desc: Retrieves information about the most recent change to a printer or print server after its notification object was signaled.

GetPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a printer at the requested level (PRINTER_INFO_n structure).

SetPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets data for a printer, or pauses, resumes or purges it.

BroadcastSystemMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a message to the specified recipients, such as applications, drivers or network drivers.

CascadeWindows@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cascades the specified child windows of a parent window; returns the number of windows arranged.

ChangeMenu@WIN32API.INC.desc: Obsolete; replaced by AppendMenu, InsertMenu, ModifyMenu and RemoveMenu.

CheckMenuRadioItem@WIN32API.INC.desc: Checks a menu item and makes it a radio item, clearing the other items in the given range.

ChildWindowFromPointEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines which child window of a parent contains a point, optionally skipping invisible, disabled or transparent ones.

CloseDesktop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an open handle to a desktop object.

CloseWindowStation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes an open window station handle.

CreateDesktop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new desktop, associates it with the current window station and returns a handle to it.

CreateDialogIndirectParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a modeless dialog box from a template in memory, passing an initialization value to the dialog procedure.

CreateDialogParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a modeless dialog box from a dialog template resource, passing an initialization value to the dialog procedure.

DialogBoxIndirectParam@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates and runs a modal dialog box from a template in memory; returns the value passed to EndDialog.

DragDetect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Captures the mouse and tracks it until the user releases the button, presses ESC or moves outside the drag rectangle; returns nonzero if a drag started.

DragObject@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: undocumented user32 export used for dragging an object (cursor) between windows.

DrawAnimatedRects@WIN32API.INC.desc: Animates a rectangle (e.g. caption) opening, closing, minimizing or maximizing a window.

DrawCaption_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a window caption in the given rectangle of a device context.

DrawEdge_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws one or more edges of a rectangle with 3-D effects (raised, sunken, etc.).

DrawFrameControl_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws a frame control such as a button, caption button, menu glyph or scroll bar of the given type and style.

DrawState@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays an image (text, icon, bitmap) and applies a visual effect such as disabled or default state.

DrawTextEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws formatted text in a rectangle with extra options such as tab stops and margins (DRAWTEXTPARAMS).

EnumDesktops@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all desktops of a window station, passing each desktop name to a callback.

EnumDesktopWindows@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all top-level windows on a desktop, passing each handle to a callback.

EnumPropsEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all entries in the property list of a window, passing each to a callback with an extra application value.

EnumProps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all entries in the property list of a window, passing each to a callback.

EnumThreadWindows@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all non-child windows associated with a thread, passing each handle to a callback.

EnumWindowStations@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates all window stations in the current session, passing each name to a callback.

FindWindowEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Finds a window whose class name and window name match, searching child windows starting after a given child; returns its handle.

GetKeyboardLayoutList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the input locale identifiers (keyboard layout handles) for the system's active input locales; returns their count.

GetMenuContextHelpId@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the Help context identifier associated with the specified menu.

GetMenuDefaultItem@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the identifier or position of the default item of a menu, or -1 if there is none.

GetMenuItemInfo_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a menu item into a MENUITEMINFO structure.

GetMenuItemRect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the bounding rectangle of a menu item in screen coordinates.

GetScrollInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves scroll bar parameters (range, page size, position, thumb position) into a SCROLLINFO structure.

GetSysColorBrush@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns a handle to a cached brush for a system color index; the brush must not be deleted.

GetUserObjectInformation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a window station or desktop object (name, type, flags).

GetWindowContextHelpId@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the Help context identifier associated with a window.

GetWindowRgn@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the window region of a window into a given region; returns the region type.

GrayString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Draws gray (dimmed) text at a location, using a callback or default text output.

InsertMenuItem_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Inserts a new menu item at the given position in a menu, described by a MENUITEMINFO structure.

LookupIconIdFromDirectoryEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Searches icon or cursor directory data for the image that best fits the given size and color format; returns its resource ID.

MapVirtualKeyEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Translates between virtual-key codes, scan codes and characters using the given keyboard layout.

MenuItemFromPoint@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the zero-based position of the menu item at a screen point, or -1 if none.

MessageBoxIndirect@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates and displays a message box described by a MSGBOXPARAMS structure (custom icon, help, language); returns the button pressed.

OpenDesktop@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens the specified desktop object and returns a handle to it.

OpenWindowStation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens the specified window station and returns a handle to it.

RegisterClassEx_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers a window class described by a WNDCLASSEX structure (including small icon); returns a class atom.

SetMenuContextHelpId@WIN32API.INC.desc: Associates a Help context identifier with a menu.

SetMenuDefaultItem@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the default item of a menu, by identifier or position.

SetMenuItemInfo_WIN32API@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes information about a menu item using a MENUITEMINFO structure.

SetMessageExtraInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the extra message information for the current thread; returns the previous value.

SetUserObjectInformation@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets information about a window station or desktop object.

SetWindowContextHelpId@WIN32API.INC.desc: Associates a Help context identifier with a window.
